comment: This target is used for documentation and future -Z build-std use.
Phase 1 binaries are built against x86_64-unknown-none with RUSTFLAGS
pointing at services/user-space.ld; this JSON describes the intended ABI.
- Entry symbol: _start (see sunlight_libc::crt0 for register convention)
- argc in rdi, argv in rsi, envp in rdx
- Stack 16-byte aligned at entry; argc also placed at [rsp]
- No dynamic linking; all binaries are statically linked
- No red zone (kernel syscall entry does not guarantee red zone safety)
- SSE/MMX disabled (kernel runs with soft-float RUSTFLAGS)
